Specify priors

Source: R/priors.R
pk_priors.Rd

Named arguments set priors: structural parameters (CL = lognormal(...)), estimated covariate effects by their names (b_wt = normal(...)), the standard deviation of between-subject variability per parameter (omega_CL = half_normal(...)) or for all (omega = half_normal(...)), residual error (sigma_add, sigma_prop, or sigma_log for log-scale error) and the LKJ shape for correlations (lkj = 2). Anything not given gets a default, shown by bpk_fit() and stored in the fit.

Usage

pk_priors(...)

Arguments

...

Named priors.

Value

An object of class bpk_priors.

Details

Default priors for typical values are centred on rough data-based values (non-compartmental estimates from the first dose) with a log-scale standard deviation of 2, that is, a factor of about 7 per standard deviation. They are weakly informative only; give informative priors when prior knowledge exists.

Examples

pk_priors(CL = lognormal(log(5), 0.5), omega = half_normal(0.5))
#> $CL
#> $dist
#> [1] "lognormal"
#> 
#> $mu
#> [1] 1.609438
#> 
#> $sd
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bpk_prior"
#> 
#> $omega
#> $dist
#> [1] "half_normal"
#> 
#> $mu
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $sd
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bpk_prior"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bpk_priors"
